signal_timing: Factor is formed after the close of signal date T.
entry_rule: Buy at the open of the first trading day after T.
exit_rule: Sell at the open of the 21st trading day after T.
missing_price_treatment: A stock is excluded for that signal date when entry or exit open price is missing or non-positive.
execution_constraint_note: Suspension, limit-up and tradability constraints are not included in this first factor-effectiveness test.
